categories.name: Express Air Couplings
categories.shortDescription: Express (NF E 29573) claw couplings for compressed air and water: half couplings with male or female BSP thread or hose shank, plugs and seals, in brass, steel and 316 stainless.
categories.seoDescription: Express claw couplings to NF E 29573 for compressed air and water: BSP male and female half couplings, hose shanks, plugs and seals, 1/2" to 1".

hero.intro: Express couplings are symmetrical claw couplings for compressed air and water: two identical halves turn together and lock, with a seal in each half. They are standardised in NF E 29573 and fitted to air tools, compressors and site air lines.

items.q: Are Express couplings the same as Chicago (universal) couplings?
items.a: No. Both are claw couplings, but Express couplings follow NF E 29573 and are not interchangeable with the US-pattern universal air coupling.

categories.name: Steam Hose Couplings
categories.shortDescription: Steam hose couplings to EN 14423: male stems, bosses (mouthpieces), wing nuts and reducers in steel and brass, 1/2" to 2", fitted with 2- or 4-bolt steam clamps.
categories.seoDescription: EN 14423 steam hose couplings: male stems, bosses, wing nuts and reducers in steel and brass, 1/2" to 2", clamped with 2- or 4-bolt safety clamps.

hero.intro: Steam hose couplings to EN 14423 join a saturated steam hose to plant piping with a ground-joint seal. A stem or boss is clamped into the hose with a bolted safety clamp and the halves are pulled together by a wing nut. Steel and brass parts are listed from 1/2" to 2".

items.q: Why are steam hose couplings clamped and not banded?
items.a: Saturated steam hoses run hot and at pressure, so EN 14423 couplings are held with bolted safety clamps that grip the hose evenly and can be re-tightened after the hose settles.

categories.seoDescription: DIN 28450 TW tank-wagon couplings: union couplers, male adapters, chained caps and flat or lip gaskets, DN 50 to DN 100, brass, aluminium and 316 stainless.

hero.intro: TW couplings to DIN 28450 connect hoses to road and rail tank wagons for fuels, oils and chemicals. A union coupler with a swivel nut screws onto the wagon's male adapter, with a flat or lip gasket between them; chained caps close the outlets in transit.

items.q: Which gasket does a TW coupling need?
items.a: Either a flat gasket or a lip gasket in the coupler, in a material chosen for the product, such as NBR for fuels and oils, FKM or PTFE for aggressive chemicals.

products.descriptionLong:
A sanitary hinged clamp is the clamp that closes around a pair of mating flanged ends and a gasket to make a sanitary joint that can be opened quickly for cleaning.   • Closes around two flanged ends and the gasket between them

  • Wine lines

products.descriptionLong:
A DIN 11851 sanitary male hose coupling part is the male half of a union with a hose connection. It takes the union nut from the female half and seals against it through a gasket. This one is made in 316 stainless steel from NW 25 to NW 100, and is supplied from Dubai, UAE.

  • Male half of the union, with a hose connection
  • Takes the union nut from the female half
  • Dimension A equal to NW at every size

Applications

  • Food and beverage hose lines
  • Chemical process lines
  • Pharmaceutical process lines

Sizes and ratings

Six nominal widths are listed: NW 25, 38, 50, 65, 80 and 100. NW 38 is a non-ISO width as printed in the catalogue, and is kept. Dimension A equals NW at every size. A size table follows with 6 part numbers, each giving size, material and dimensions. Weights are not published, and no pressure rating is stated in the source.

A hose coupling part is chosen by the hose as well as the joint. The hose connection must suit the hose bore and wall, and the hose must be secured with a clamp or ferrule suited to food duty. Because NW 38 is a non-ISO width, confirm that your female half and nut are also NW 38 before ordering. Send the nominal width and hose type with the enquiry, and we check the pairing.

Ordering

A Storz coupling gasket is the sealing ring in the face of a Storz coupling. One gasket is listed per Storz size, in black neoprene and in white neoprene described as food quality, so the right ring can be matched to the coupling and the product.

Construction

  • Neoprene, black (standard) and white (food quality)
  • Four size designations: 25-D, 52-C, 75-B and 110-A
  • Each reference lists the thread sizes it goes with
  • Weights from 0.003 kg to 0.043 kg

The gasket is neoprene in black, or in white described as food quality. Take the white version where a food-quality seal is needed; the catalogue does not state its approval basis, so confirm in writing if a certificate is required.

Applications

  • Replacing worn gaskets in Storz couplings
  • Fire-fighting and irrigation lines
  • Powder and hydrocarbon transfer

The neoprene sealing gasket that sits in the face of a Storz coupling. It seals the joint between two Storz halves on fire-fighting, irrigation, powder and hydrocarbon lines and is replaced when it wears.

Sizes and ratings

Each gasket reference covers a coupling size and its thread sizes: 25-D for 1/2, 3/4 and 1 inch, 52-C for 1 1/2 and 2 inch, 75-B for 2 1/2 and 3 inch, and 110-A for 4 inch. The catalogue shows both black and white neoprene for each, and does not explain the size letters. A size table follows with 8 part numbers, each row giving its size and material. Choose the gasket by the Storz size designation on the coupling; if the designation is unclear, send the coupling size and thread size or a photo.

Ordering

To quote, send the Storz size designation (25-D, 52-C, 75-B or 110-A), black or white neoprene, the medium and the quantity. The gasket seats in a Storz coupling of the same size designation, such as the hose coupling, threaded coupling, reducing coupling or blind cap, and seals against the mating half. Because two nominal pressure figures are published for the range, confirm the required rating in writing before ordering. Supplied from Dubai, UAE.

products.descriptionShort: Storz blind cap in aluminium, bronze or 316 stainless steel that closes an open Storz coupling, sizes 25-D to 250 with claw distance KA 31 to 278 mm, from Indus Hydraulics in the UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
A Storz blind cap is a blank cap that closes the open end of a Storz coupling. It locks on with the same claws as a coupling, keeping dirt out and sealing the line when it is not in use.

Construction

  • Aluminium from 25-D up to 250
  • Bronze at 25-D, 52-C, 75-B, 110-A and 150
  • 316 stainless steel at 25-D, 52-C, 75-B and 110-A
  • Claw distance KA and weight listed per size, 0.09 kg to 8.94 kg

Aluminium is listed from 25-D to 250, bronze at five sizes up to 150, and 316 stainless steel at the four smaller sizes. There is no bronze or stainless cap above 150 and 110-A respectively, so large sizes are aluminium only.

Applications

  • Closing idle Storz outlets and hose ends
  • Fire-fighting and irrigation lines
  • Powder and hydrocarbon transfer lines

A blank Storz cap that closes the open end of a coupling. It keeps dirt out of idle Storz outlets and hose ends, and seals the line on fire-fighting, irrigation, powder and hydrocarbon systems.

Sizes and ratings

Sixteen references are listed: aluminium from 25-D to 250, bronze at 25-D, 52-C, 75-B, 110-A and 150, and 316 stainless steel at 25-D, 52-C, 75-B and 110-A. Claw distance KA runs from 31 to 278 mm. The catalogue does not explain the size letters. A size table follows with 16 part numbers, each row giving its size and material. Choose the cap by the Storz size designation of the coupling it closes, and use the KA figure to check the match if the designation is not marked.

Ordering

To quote, send the Storz size designation, the material (aluminium, bronze or 316 stainless), the medium and the quantity. The cap fits any Storz half of the same size designation, such as a hose coupling, threaded coupling or reducing coupling, and uses the gasket in that half for its seal. Because two nominal pressure figures are published for the range, confirm the required rating in writing before ordering. Supplied from Dubai, UAE.

products.descriptionLong:
A Guillemin coupling gasket is the sealing ring for a Guillemin symmetrical coupling. Each size is listed with its outside diameter and two thickness dimensions (E and H), so the right gasket can be matched by measurement as well as by size.

Construction

  • EPDM (white, non-toxic), PTFE, NBR (black) and FKM compounds
  • Outside diameter, E and H dimensions per row
  • Sizes DN 15 to DN 100
  • Weights from 0.001 kg to 0.06 kg

Four compounds are listed: EPDM in white and described as non-toxic, PTFE, black NBR and FKM. The catalogue does not give chemical resistance tables, so confirm the compound for your product in writing before ordering.

Applications

  • Replacing gaskets in Guillemin couplings
  • Petroleum and chemical transfer
  • Powder and food product transfer

The sealing ring that sits in the face of a Guillemin symmetrical coupling. It seals the joint on petroleum, chemical, powder and food lines, and is replaced when it wears or is attacked by the product.

Sizes and ratings

Thirty-one gaskets are tabulated in DN 15, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 65, 80 and 100. The DN 40 PTFE weight (0.06 kg) looks out of line with its neighbours, so it is confirmed at quotation. The Guillemin range is catalogued to NF E 29572 with a nominal pressure of 16 bar. A size table follows with 31 part numbers, each row giving its size and material. Choose the gasket by the DN of the coupling, then by the compound that suits the product; if the old ring is available, compare its outside diameter and thickness to the catalogue figures.

Ordering

To quote, send the DN size, the gasket compound (EPDM, PTFE, NBR or FKM), the medium, the temperature and the quantity. The gasket seats in a Guillemin coupling of the same DN, such as the hose tail, threaded, reducing or plug versions, and seals against the mating symmetrical half. Because no per-size pressure is printed, confirm duty, pressure and temperature in writing before ordering. Supplied from Dubai, UAE.

products.title: PTFE-Coated Breakaway Safety Coupling with Dry Break, 316L Stainless Steel, 1"–12"
products.descriptionShort: Breakaway safety coupling with dry break, PTFE-coated inside, in 316L stainless steel from 1" to 12", for aggressive products that cannot touch metal, from Indus Hydraulics in the UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
A PTFE-coated breakaway safety coupling sits between a hose or loading arm and a mobile loading point. If the tanker pulls away, the weakened bolts fail before the hose or arm does, and valves in each half close to stop spillage. This version is PTFE coated inside, in 316L stainless steel, for 1" to 12" and supplied from Dubai, UAE.

Construction

  • Body in 316L stainless steel, PTFE coated
  • Coated so aggressive products do not contact metal
  • Both halves seal on parting
  • Re-armed by replacing the broken bolts
  • Ends: BSP or NPT thread; ANSI 150 and 300 flanges; DN25–150 PN10/25
  • PTFE gaskets rated -200 to +250 °C

Applications

  • Chemical, food and pharmaceutical loading
  • Tanker and rail-car transfer

Sizes and ratings

The working pressure is PN 10 to PN 25 bar, and sizes run from 1" to 12" (DN25 and up). No size table is attached, because individual sizes and the rating per size are not tabulated, so the pressure rating per size is confirmed at quotation. The PTFE gaskets are rated -200 to +250 °C. The source for this type is the web page only, as no catalogue page covers the PTFE-coated type.

A breakaway coupling is a safety device and is specified from the duty, not from a catalogue size. The size, the end connections, the product and the pull-away risk all count, and so does the temperature of the PTFE gaskets. Send these with the enquiry, and the quotation sets out the coupling, the bolt set and the spare bolts needed to re-arm it.

Ordering

To order, give the size, the end connection, the seal material, the product and temperature and the quantity. Because the release load is set by the bolts, also state the hose or arm size and the pull-away risk so the bolt set can be confirmed. Supplied from Dubai, UAE.
